a.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Larvik Line.

b.text: She was renamed MS Peter Wessel and started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route.

a.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Larvik Line until 1996.

b.text: Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.

a.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Color Line.

b.text: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners.

a.text: She sailed as MS Peter Wessel for Color Line.

b.text: She entered service on SNAV's Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service.
